mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag != '1') ORDER BY request_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (id, user_id, account_no, channel, status, request_time, close_time, priority, agent_id, agent_name, is_transfer_agent, current_reply_status, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, del_flag, remarks) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{accountNo}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{requestTime}, #{closeTime}, #{priority}, #{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{isTransferAgent}, #{currentReplyStatus}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateTime}, #{updateBy}, #{delFlag}, #{remarks})
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET user_id = #{userId}, account_no = #{accountNo}, channel = #{channel}, status = #{status}, request_time = #{requestTime}, close_time = #{closeTime}, priority = #{priority}, agent_id = #{agentId}, agent_name = #{agentName}, is_transfer_agent = #{isTransferAgent}, current_reply_status = #{currentReplyStatus}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, del_flag = #{delFlag}, remarks = #{remarks} WHERE id = #{id}
